headline: Yandex (x3), Sberbank, VKontakte damaged
dek: Ukraine this month hit three Yandex data centers, one Sberbank, one VKontakte with drone attacks. Companies coy on damage, but widespread lasting disruptions: banking, e-commerce, geolocation, ride-hailing, Yandex's Alisa assistant, multimodal AI chatbots; arbitration courts canceling/postponing…
fault_line: Strategic infrastructure or civilian harm — when does hitting a data center become a cyberattack on civilians?

sections.what_happened: Ukraine this month hit three Yandex data centers, one Sberbank, one VKontakte with drone attacks. Companies coy on damage, but widespread lasting disruptions: banking, e-commerce, geolocation, ride-hailing, Yandex's Alisa assistant, multimodal AI chatbots; arbitration courts canceling/postponing sessions. Experts: repairs could take months if not years. Mikhail Klimarev (Internet Protection Society): 'This effectively sets Russia far behind in the AI race.' Data centers now targeted by both sides.
sections.what_verified: AP original reporting; consistent with prior scan coverage of Ukrainian refinery/data strikes.
sections.what_disputed: Yandex, Sberbank, VKontakte have not confirmed the extent of damage; repair timelines are expert estimates.
sections.why_matters: The war went digital: Ukraine took Russia's internet backbone offline and the courts felt it. Map the five targets, show what stopped working for ordinary Russians, keep company non-confirmation on screen as a label.
sections.context: Background: Ukraine hits Russian data centers — Yandex (x3), Sberbank, VKontakte damaged; banking/e-commerce/courts disrupted, repair could take years (AP)

totw_analysis: Our read: The war went digital: Ukraine took Russia's internet backbone offline and the courts felt it. Map the five targets, show what stopped working for ordinary Russians, keep company non-confirmation on screen as a label. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Strategic infrastructure or civilian harm — when does hitting a data center become a cyberattack on civilians?
